WITH account_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) as avg_signed_amount
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall_avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(transaction_count AS REAL)) as avg_count
  FROM account_stats
)
SELECT 
  account_stats.account_id,
  account_stats.avg_signed_amount,
  account_stats.transaction_count,
  CAST(account_stats.transaction_count AS REAL) / overall_avg_count.avg_count as ratio
FROM account_stats, overall_avg_count
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
